subject: Chemistry
module_name: Application of Core Principles of Chemistry

specification_points.description: Define rate of reaction; describe factors affecting rate
Explain collision theory and the effect of temperature on rate
Draw and interpret Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution curves
Explain the role of catalysts in lowering activation energy
Explain dynamic equilibrium and Le Chatelier's principle
Write expressions for Kc and calculate values with units
Explain how changes in temperature, pressure, and concentration affect Kc
Apply equilibrium principles to the Haber process and Contact process
Understand nomenclature: IUPAC naming of alkanes, alkenes, halogenoalkanes, alcohols
Distinguish between homologous series, functional groups, structural isomers
Describe free radical substitution of alkanes (initiation, propagation, termination)
Describe electrophilic addition to alkenes (mechanism with curly arrows)
Explain Markovnikov's rule for addition to unsymmetrical alkenes
Describe the reactions of alkenes with Br₂, HBr, H₂SO₄/H₂O, and H₂
Describe nucleophilic substitution of halogenoalkanes (SN1 and SN2 mechanisms)
Describe oxidation of primary, secondary, and tertiary alcohols with K₂Cr₂O₇/H₂SO₄
Describe dehydration of alcohols and esterification
